communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

concerning the FDA's review of increased MedWatch reports involving extended-release ADHD stimulant medications, as described in the agency's FY2024 Report on the State of Pharmaceutical Quality.

Specifically, the report stated:

“FDA is reviewing the recent increase in MedWatch reports for extended-release ADHD stimulant products to determine necessary responses, which may include additional information requests, sampling and testing, or inspections.”

I request the final assessment, decision memorandum, or most recent substantive status report documenting the findings, status, or disposition of this specific review.

I am particularly interested in whether FDA determined that further investigation was warranted, whether the review remains ongoing or has been closed, and whether any product-specific quality concerns were identified.

Date range: January 1, 2024, through the date this request is processed.

To keep this request narrowly focused, I am not seeking individual MedWatch reports, raw adverse-event data, manufacturer submissions, laboratory testing records, inspection reports, or general correspondence.

Please limit the search to the Office of Quality Surveillance within the Center for Drug Evaluation and Research's Office of Pharmaceutical Quality, and any office directly responsible for documenting the conclusions or status of this specific review.

If no final assessment exists, please provide the most recent completed substantive status report, briefing memorandum, or decision document concerning the review. I am requesting existing records only and do not ask FDA to create a new report.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma Yasinski

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ellen
